Angels With Filthy Souls.desc:
​"Acey tells me you’re sniffin' around for a winter warmer..."

​Is that a fact? Well, Acey ain’t in charge no more.

​What you’re gonna get is a glass full of the heavy stuff. We’re talkin’ a deep garnet pour with a hit of orange peel sharp enough to wake the neighbors. It’s a full-bodied pillar of ale, see? But don’t let the looks fool ya. She comes to you with a filthy soul, packing a heater of Tomahawk hops that roughs up the holiday spice right at center stage.
​So I’m gonna give you to the count of 10 to get your ugly, yella, no-good belly chocked-full of Angels with Filthy Souls.

​1... 2... 10!

Gutless Rusty.desc: Gutless Rusty is a bold, brooding vanilla pumpkin spiced porter aged on bourbon-soaked oak, brewed in defiance of convention and in honor of the legendary XFL coach Rusty Tillman—the man who stood his ground when Jesse “The Body” Ventura tried to play puppetmaster. This beer is a rich, smoldering rebellion in a glass: layers of roasted malt and velvety pumpkin glide over a backbone of warm spice and smooth vanilla, while hints of charred oak and bourbon remind you that even when you’re called “gutless,” standing firm still leaves a hell of a legacy. Sip it like Rusty coached—without compromise.

It Was All A Dreamsicle.desc:
You thought you knew IPAs? Nah, son. This ain't your daddy's bitter brew. This is "It Was All a Dreamsicle," and trust, it’s about to change the game.
​We took the old-school juicy vibe and flipped the script. We soured it up—dropping a little tartness just to let you know this brew got hustle—then we milkshaked the remix. We’re talking a heavy dose of lactose and vanilla for a body that’s thicker than a bassline and smoother than a velvet tracksuit.
​Then comes the drop: Dolcita hops. A straight-up flavor powerhouse delivering sticky-sweet candied orange. It’s a tart, creamy, citrus masterpiece—like a summer day on the stoop, sippin' on that melted orange-cream dream.
​It smells like money. It tastes like success. It’s the kind of beer that makes you wanna slide into the booth and count your paper. Don't be mad, this is the life we chose. Juicy. Sour. Milkshaked. Legendary.
